name: Royal Enfield Bullet
engine: 346 or 499 cc air-cooled pushrod single, carb (iron barrel and AVL) or fuel injected (UCE, 2009-on)
intro: The long-running Indian-built Bullet. Early iron-barrel engines, then the AVL lean-burn engine, then the fuel-injected UCE from 2009.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2009 Bullet G5 Classic EFI bikes are in recall 09V235 (clutch).
A-002.reason: The fix is free if it was never done.

A: Work out which engine you have first: iron barrel, AVL or UCE. Parts don't swap between them.
G: Bikes before 2009 have a carb. UCE bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.
